snippets.title: Read MinIO credentials from environment variables
snippets.description: Read endpoint, access key, secret key and secure flag from environment variables
snippets.code:
import os

endpoint   = os.environ["MINIO_ENDPOINT"]
access_key = os.environ["MINIO_ACCESS_KEY"]
secret_key = os.environ["MINIO_SECRET_KEY"]
secure     = os.environ.get("MINIO_SECURE", "false").lower() == "true"

snippets.title: List all objects in a bucket
snippets.description: List all files in a bucket recursively with name and size
snippets.code:
objects = client.list_objects("my-bucket", recursive=True)
for obj in objects:
    size_kb = (obj.size or 0) / 1024
    print(f"{obj.object_name:<50} {size_kb:>10.1f} KB")
